FieldReady Academy

CHTM Study Guide and Practice Tests

CHTM Academy is a free study guide and practice-test course for the AAMI/ACI Certified Healthcare Technology Manager exam. Sixty lessons follow the exam's five domains from the manager's seat, a printable CHTM cheat sheet collects the financial formulas, risk tools, operations metrics, regulators, and labor laws worth memorizing, adaptive tutorials rebuild from your misses, and unlimited CHTM practice tests draw on a bank of original CHTM exam questions built from the exam's domain weights. Everything you need to prepare for the healthcare technology manager certification is here, free while the site launches.

CodeCHTM

Time120 minutes
PassingACI reports CHTM results as pass or fail and publishes no cut score. This course's official-format test uses 70%, the same bar as our CBET and CRES courses.
Course60 lessons across 8 units, about 9.6 hours of reading
CostFree

How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 100 questions in 120 minutes, at its real passing score of 70%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

Every lesson, by unit

Questions people ask

How many questions are on the CHTM exam?

100 multiple-choice questions in 2 hours, closed book, with an on-screen calculator and notepad. ACI sets the cut score with a criterion-referenced method and does not publish it; this course's official-format test uses 70%.

When is the CHTM offered?

Twice a year, May 1 to 15 and November 1 to 15, at computer-based test centers. Applications open about three months before each window.

Who is eligible for the CHTM?

One of five pathways. The common one is a current CCE, CBET, CRES, or CLES plus at least three years as an HTM supervisor or manager in the last five; our CBET Academy and CRES Academy courses prepare for two of those credentials. The others are the Department of Defense BMET program plus three years of supervision, an associate degree in biomedical technology, a related healthcare discipline, IT, or business plus three years, a bachelor's degree or higher in those fields plus two years as a manager, or seven years in HTM with three in management. Pathways without the supervisor or manager title need an attestation of management duties.

How much does the CHTM cost?

In 2026 the exam is $490 for AAMI members and $565 for non-members; a retake is $440 or $515. In 2027 the fees rise to $510 and $590, with a retake at $460 or $540. Certification is renewed every three years with continuing education.

How many practice tests should I take?

This course asks for three of your last five fifty-question practice tests at 80% or better, then one full-length test in the real exam's format at the real passing score.

Is the course free?

Yes. The lessons, the cheat sheet, and unlimited practice tests are free while the site launches.
